create_GuiInput_instance: create a GuiInput instance to hold keyboard and mouse input state for a simulation frame
check_key_held: check if a specific KeyCode is currently held down using get_key method
check_mouse_button_held: check if a specific MouseButton is currently held down using get_mouse_button method
reset_input_state: reset all discrete and continuous input states at the end of a simulation frame
copy_input_state: copy all input state from one GuiInput instance to another using copy_from method
